name: Decode kernels
configuration: dense decode linears at M ≤ 32 read FP8 weight tiles and accumulate in FP32 instead of quantizing activations per token (SGLANG_HW_FP8_SMALL_M=1)
the MoE router GEMM at M = 2–4 on the same kernel instead of cuBLAS's SM80 fallback (SGLANG_HW_ROUTER_SMALL_M=1)
fused-MoE tiles tuned for E=128, N=704 on sm_120 at M ≤ 128, SGLang's default above (SGLANG_MOE_CONFIG_DIR)
the tied 1.48 GB embedding/lm_head stored once in FP8 (SGLANG_HW_FP8_LM_HEAD=1)
text-only checkpoint view: the vision tower's 1.15 GB goes to KV
--max-running-requests 16 frees the 2.1 GB request table sized for 2,048 requests; --mem-fraction-static 0.94 gives it to KV
the three patches on SGLang 0.5.21 are not published
